question: If CPHUDQ = 6 and BOY = 6, then which of the given options will FUNDAMENTAL be equal to?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1d0a66c5c970434695f6bfb5c85de9381f1d2fd863d3668e90159ada324fb6d.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

**Sum of alphabet positional values until single digit is obtained.**

CPHUDQ = 6 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/809c0a781fcf51975b868b0281444a7bf7c201db9e400e075141ef848899f2fa.png] 

⇒ 3 + 16 + 8 + 21 + 4 + 17 = 69

⇒ 69 = 6 + 9 = 15

⇒ 1 + 5 = 6

and 

BOY = 6

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d29ca57a62538afd9845723c798ef25ad25e362df50ecac3aadb86e6a136fdf.png] 

⇒ 2 + 15 + 25 = 42

⇒ 42 = 4 + 2 = 6

Similarly,

FUNDAMENTAL will be equal to :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8dca55afb5361d595338fb3875a8e5ed27444c7a3aabf895b96c82a05a4bcc10.png] 

⇒ 6 + 21 + 14 + 4 + 1 + 13 + 5 + 14 + 20 + 1 + 12 = 111

**⇒ 111 = 1 + 1 + 1 = 3**

Hence, the correct answer is **"3".**
